_doc: MOSS-TTS-Nano online DPO settings. The three USER_REVIEW sections (beta, kl, optimizer) are left null on purpose: the user sets every value there by hand. dpo/train.py refuses to start while any required USER_REVIEW field is null (dpolib.check_user_review lists them). Rollout, scoring and pairing do not need them, so round 1 runs up to its pairs first and prints the paper's beta* diagnostic (runs/dpo/r01/pairs_summary.json) to help choose. Everything outside USER_REVIEW is a pipeline default; see dpo/README.md section 5 for each one.
_model: Which adapter (dpo/adapters/) this run trains. Its settings are models.<model>; they override the shared rollout values below.

moss_nano._policy_init: pi_ref = pi_theta_1 (Alg. 1 Require line): the SFT deliverable checkpoint, frozen for the whole run.

orpheus._policy_init: No SFT exists for Orpheus: pi_ref = the pretrained model the benchmark used.
orpheus._lora: LoRA shape (not an optimizer value). dropout must stay 0 (gates.py D3).
orpheus._reward: Orpheus's mean speaker similarity on the 494 is 0.85 (MOSS 0.95), so the shared 0.85 gate would reject about half its samples.

_rounds: Online rounds T_round (each = one rollout -> score -> pair -> train pass). Stop early after `patience` rounds without a dev BTRM % gain, or on any guard-rail failure.

texts._n: 9B-written prompt texts (sft/gen_texts.py rules: 8-40 words, no digits, deduped against all SFT texts and the 19 benchmark texts).

voices._doc: Every non-dev EARS speaker's rainbow_01_regular. The 26 benchmark speakers' prompt clip is allowed by SFT decision D6; false leaves them out.

rollout._sampling: deployment = the benchmark's decoding (benchmark/generate_moss_nano.py SAMPLING), so preferences are learned on the outputs the benchmark measures. on_policy = T 1, no top-k/top-p, no repetition penalty: samples come from exactly the pi_theta that train.py scores (Alg. 1 line 3). README section 5.2.
rollout._doc: Shared across models; models.<model>.rollout adds batch_size (multiple of k) and max_new (frames for MOSS, tokens for Orpheus).

reward._reward: Reward = SpeechJudge-BTRM scalar (a Bradley-Terry logit, the scale the paper's sigma_r^2 assumes). Hard gates make a candidate invalid (Alg. 1 line 5): no audio_end, WER > wer_max, speaker sim to the voice prompt < sim_min, duration outside sec_per_word x words. Pairs with r_w - r_l < tie_delta are ties and skipped (Alg. 1 lines 5-6).

eval._eval: Every round: the model's benchmark generator on the SFT dev mirror (228 rows, 4 held-out speakers), BTRM, WER/sim/UTMOS, then sft/compare.py vs the round-0 (pi_ref) eval with the SFT guard rails. The 494 benchmark runs once, at the end, never to choose anything.

_precision: Same as SFT decision D13: fp32 weights, bf16 autocast. Pure bf16 rounds most small updates away.
USER_REVIEW: Everything below is for the user to set. null = not decided yet. Suggested starting points with reasons are in dpo/README.md section 6; nothing here is filled in by the pipeline or the agents.

beta._doc: mode: "fixed" (beta = beta0 for the whole run) or "dual_ascent" (paper Alg. 1 line 12: beta_{t+1} = clip(beta_t + eta_beta (D_hat_t - epsilon), beta_min, beta_max), carried across rounds). beta_min, beta_max and eta_beta are only needed for dual_ascent.

kl._doc: epsilon: KL trust region (Eq. 9), also D_hat_0 (Alg. 1 line 1). Required for dual_ascent or when on_violation is not "none". ema_alpha: EMA rate of D_hat (line 10). k_hat_per: "sequence" (k_hat = 1/2 (u_w^2 + u_l^2) as in line 9) or "frame" (u divided by the completion's frame count first; sequences are ~100-300 frames x 17 tokens). on_violation (D_hat > epsilon): "none" (log only), "stop_round" (end this round's training early), "rollback" (discard this round's update). lambda: optional, only for the diagnostic beta* = (lambda sigma_r^2 / 2)^(1/3).

optimizer.name: adamw
optimizer._doc: name: "adamw" | "adam" | "rmsprop" | "sgd". betas [b1, b2] and eps for adam/adamw; alpha (smoothing) and eps for rmsprop; momentum for sgd. max_grad_norm: clip value (paper section 4: ||g_t|| <= 2 beta_t G), 0 = no clipping. scheduler: "constant" | "linear" | "cosine" (per round). batch_pairs x grad_accum = pairs per optimizer step (Alg. 1 is 1 pair per step). epochs_per_round: passes over the round's fresh pairs (1 = each pair used once, no stale reuse). state_across_rounds: "reset" | "carry" (optimizer moments).

_user_review_filled: 2026-10-28 trial 2 on runnerup (user): paper Alg. 1, beta0 = beta* = sqrt(20.7245 / 2 x 10.0) = 1.0180 from this pi_ref's own round-1 sigma_r^2; dual ascent in [beta*/3, 3 beta*], eta_t = 0.01/sqrt(t), k_hat per sequence; AdamW lr 1e-6 unchanged.
